client.business_model: Multi-site women's health provider offering OB-GYN, ancillary women-focused services and telehealth across several U.S. states
client.client_history: Founded in 2014 by Sean Glass, Advantia Health has expanded through acquisitions (including Heartland Women’s Healthcare in 2019) and now delivers integrated women’s healthcare via more than 60 clinics and telehealth capabilities. The company has attracted growth investments from Deerfield Management (2016) and BlueMountain Capital Management (2020) to accelerate its expansion.

revenue.notes: No official figure released. Third-party databases give conflicting estimates: Buzzfile $29.1 M, Growjo $22.4 M, Zippia $13 M, CanvasBusinessModel $89 M (outlier). Using mid-point of Buzzfile and Growjo (~$25 M) but treating confidence as low.

locations.source: PR Newswire press release on Heartland acquisition (2019) stating company 'operates over 60 OB-GYN and coordinated specialist offices'; corroborated by company website locations page list.
locations.notes: Exact count not enumerated, but multiple official sources use 'over 60'. Using 60 as conservative integer.

employees.notes: Employee estimates vary: LeadIQ 501, SignalHire 500-1,000, Buzzfile 259, Zippia 750, Indeed range 501-1,000. Selected Zippia’s concrete figure of 750; wide variance lowers confidence.
